=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:463-464, 1554 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `cd` to an unknown directory sets `unresolved_directory_change = True` and `explicit_git_directory = True` (line 475), but never sets `unresolved_directory_selector = True`. The new check at line 1554 gates only on `invocation.unresolved_directory_selector`, so `cd` commands fall through to the warning path instead of asking for confirmation.
  WHY: Five `cd` test cases in `test_env_unresolved_commit_directory_asks_instead_of_checking_checkout` and two `cd` commit cases in `test_unknown_directory_push_asks_but_commit_warns` fail in CI. The guard checks the session checkout's PR history instead of blocking, which is the exact regression the last-run diff was meant to fix with a narrower condition.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:1574-1577 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The remaining config-override check `target.warning` and `invocation.config_override` still adds an unverified destination when any `env` wrapper or Git config override appears inside shell control. When the shell control prefix strips `working_directory` to `None`, `uncertain` becomes `True`, `target.warning` is set, and `config_override` is `True` for any `env` prefix or `-c`/`GIT_CONFIG_*` option — not just directory selectors. The new `unresolved_directory_selector` field at line 1554 correctly handles the "real" directory-selector cases but line 1574-1577 duplicates the same concern without the selector gate.
  WHY: Three `test_unrelated_override_does_not_prompt_for_shell_control_commit` cases (`env FOO=bar`, `git -c user.name=bot`, `GIT_CONFIG_COUNT=0`) all fail in CI. The guard asks for confirmation when the PR says it should only warn.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:1557 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The emitted reason is `"could not resolve the git commit directory"` (with "the") but the existing test at `tests/test_pr_merge_status_guard.py:1464` asserts the substring `"could not resolve git commit directory"` (without "the"). The "the" prevents the substring match because it sits between "resolve " and "git commit directory".
  WHY: The two `GIT_DIR=` cases in `test_env_unresolved_commit_directory_asks_instead_of_checking_checkout` reach line 1463-1464 and the substring assertion fails. CI confirms: `assert 'could not resolve git commit directory' in 'merged-PR guard needs confirmation: ... could not resolve the git c...'`
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: PR description states "Unrelated `env`/Git config in shell control does not turn a warning-only unresolved commit into an ask" and the new test `test_unrelated_override_does_not_prompt_for_shell_control_commit` verifies this.
  Expected change site: .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:1574-1577 and workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:1574-1577
  Evidence of absence: The LAST RUN DIFF removed the broad `explicit_git_directory` check at old lines 1546-1548 but did not modify the check at lines 1574-1577. Line 1575 still checks only `invocation.config_override`, not `invocation.unresolved_directory_selector`, so any `env`-wrapped or `-c`-flag commit from an uncertain directory (including shell-control uncertainty) enters `unverified_destinations` and asks. Three CI failures confirm this.
  SEVERITY: critical
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: PR description states "a commit whose directory selector cannot be resolved ... asks for confirmation without querying the session checkout's PR history" and the pre-existing test `test_env_unresolved_commit_directory_asks_instead_of_checking_checkout` verifies this for `cd` cases.
  Expected change site: .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py around lines 463-464 or line 1554
  Evidence of absence: The LAST RUN DIFF removed the check that used `explicit_git_directory` to catch `cd` cases but did not add `unresolved_directory_selector = True` to the `cd` path at lines 463-464. The `cd` handler only sets `unresolved_directory_change = True`, and the new check at line 1554 only gates on `unresolved_directory_selector`, so `cd` cases fall through to warning-only. Five `cd` test cases fail in CI.
  SEVERITY: critical
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
